changes.title: Ferry evidence and recovery
changes.description: Conservative Dover–Calais ferry transitions, preserved recording and explicit split/restore review. Missing ferry GPS is never invented.

changes.title: Transport and matching reliability
changes.description: Unhinted vehicle-speed movement stays Unknown; bounded matching retries and distance-integrity diagnostics preserve your original GPS evidence.

changes.title: Faster map preparation
changes.description: Unchanged journeys reuse compact map geometry and road coverage contributions. Newly changed journeys rebuild only their own records.

changes.title: Retained NCN assessment
changes.description: Duplicate saves and metadata-only updates no longer require NCN evidence reassessment. Existing New Journeys review is preserved.

changes.title: Responsive map loading
changes.description: Stale map snapshots are rejected before decoding, and map publication avoids repeated camera fitting. Private owner testing only.

changes.title: NCN history reuse
changes.description: Unchanged journeys reuse saved assessments; newly saved journeys no longer require rereading the entire archive.

changes.title: New journey review
changes.description: New recordings enter a saved review inbox that can appear while the map is loading.

changes.title: Map startup
changes.description: Journey projections and larger compressed map snapshots reduce repeated archive preparation. Local diagnostics separate loading stages.

changes.title: NCN responsiveness
changes.description: Catalogue installation no longer blocks UI polling. Unchanged NCN history restores from a validated checkpoint; stale map work stops early.

changes.title: National Cycle Network achievements
changes.description: First discovery and combined 25%, 50%, 75% and complete milestones for supported verified-open routes and the unique physical network. Walking, running and cycling qualify.

changes.title: Private owner testing
changes.description: This development build adds local performance diagnostics and retains the established map and Progress layout.

changes.title: Consistent route identifiers
changes.description: Compact NCN rows use purple identifier badges with white text beside completion bars and percentages. Focused motorway, A-road and NCN summaries use matching coloured badges.

changes.title: Collection search and activity filters
changes.description: NCN uses the shared labelled collection search box and selected filter buttons. Search spans all route groups; clearing restores browsing groups. Activity changes preserve the query and update completion without rebuilding search controls.

changes.title: Private development review
changes.description: Signed artifact only. No Firebase tester distribution or notifications; wider beta release still requires explicit owner approval. National catalogue and eligibility rules unchanged.

changes.title: NCN presentation refinement
changes.description: Private development review: consistent bicycle collection cards, clearer shared coverage summaries, purple route cards and solid orange remaining NCN geometry.

changes.title: Navigation and celebrations
changes.description: Corrected NCN Progress jump selection and chip visibility, centred achievement celebration headings and aligned Close.

changes.title: Controlled distribution
changes.description: Development builds produce a signed APK artifact only. Tester distribution requires a separate manual owner approval of the exact source and APK checksum.

changes.title: National Cycle Network beta
changes.description: Enable NCN in Collections to assess saved walking, running and cycling evidence. Browse supported open sections, mode-specific unique progress, focused route maps and eligible contributing journeys. Driving never earns NCN credit.

changes.title: Shared Progress maps
changes.description: Motorway and A-road white tracks, road fitting, zoom controls and retained journey cards continue from the corrective beta. NCN maps use purple completed and grey dashed remaining geometry.

changes.title: Conservative evidence handling
changes.description: 34 held identities and deferred alternatives remain explicit. NCN228 is a preserved alternative inventory without an open-route completion percentage. No independently verified Named route records are present in this checkpoint.

changes.title: Map loading correction
changes.description: Allow large cold maps to finish, publish geometry before optional cache writes, bypass cached results on Retry/Reset after a failure, and show consistent map readiness in the footer.

changes.title: Matching Progress charts
changes.description: Focused motorway and A-road cards now share the actual white-track Progress component, with existing blue/green fills and unchanged values.

changes.title: Focused-road camera fit
changes.description: Fit full motorway/A-road geometry or recorded B/local sections when geometry and viewport are ready. Preserve manual zoom during secondary loading.

changes.title: Recoverable map filters
changes.description: Apply filters without losing the previous map. Cancel, Reset, timeout and Retry prevent a trapped loading screen; map work runs independently of background history scans.

changes.title: Clearer focused road maps
changes.description: Brighter white progress tracks with blue motorway or green A-road completion, clearer distances, balanced headers and a prominent contributing-journeys action. B/local maps focus on recorded sections and journey lists.

changes.title: Beta 1 continuity
changes.description: Welcome-back overlay and prepared-map dismissal retained. Existing journeys, tracking, matching, achievements, collections and independent A1/A1(M) coverage preserved.

changes.title: A clearer welcome back
changes.description: New journey discoveries appear over the prepared map. Dismiss or open their actions to reveal the map controls without another map load.

changes.title: Focused road maps
changes.description: See a loading map container and statistics placeholders, then road coverage and a graphical whole-road summary. Focused maps now share the main map zoom buttons and retain bounded retry handling.

changes.title: Consistent road and journey details
changes.description: Whole-road and selected-section statistics are clearly labelled. Contributing journeys share the main journey typography, transport badges, local dates and available details. Close controls align with their content edges.

changes.title: Existing road identities retained
changes.description: A1 and A1(M) keep their independent coverage and mileage. Tracking, matching and collections remain as in the working stabilisation release. Please verify these UI changes on your device.

changes.title: Beta 1 stabilisation
changes.description: Journey filters open immediately and map controls wait until road loading finishes. Pending achievement celebrations can be opened while progress refreshes.

changes.title: Road maps and faster return visits
changes.description: Focused road maps load independently of background history and offer retry on failure or timeout. Tabs retain their screens, map position and progress scroll. Map loading streams only the evidence needed for display, preserving saved journeys and corrections.

changes.title: Device checks still needed
changes.description: Please check map filters, pending celebrations, M2 coverage and contributing journeys, then switch tabs and return. Pixel and Samsung first-load timings still need real-device verification. No NCN changes are included.

changes.title: Beta 1: journey reliability
changes.description: Improved stationary drift protection, arrival and departure timing, walking/driving boundaries and interrupted recording recovery. Existing journeys remain explicitly rematchable with their raw recordings preserved.

changes.title: Continuous driving routes
changes.description: Longer verified matching context improves motorway and local-road matching while preserving route continuity and disclosing unsupported GPS gaps.

changes.title: Service-station visits
changes.description: Mapped service grounds and timed dwell evidence distinguish genuine visits from passing traffic. Saved recordings with sufficient evidence can recover previously missed visits.

changes.title: Interactive road Progress
changes.description: Open focused motorway, A-road, B-road and local-road views where supported, with contributing journeys. Map filters and late-saved journey refresh are also included.

changes.title: Beta testing requirements
changes.description: Please test overnight home/school stays, venue running laps, walk–drive–walk transitions and screen-off recovery on Pixel/Samsung. Automated checks do not establish device acceptance. GPS gaps over 90 seconds may prevent automatic venue credit. National Cycle Network collection is reserved for Beta 2.

changes.title: Clearer navigation
changes.description: The icons along the bottom of the app now share the larger size you see in Collections, making it easier to move between screens.

changes.title: More places to explore
changes.description: Road totals and settlement boundaries are now available for 9,072 places across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Your existing road names and progress are preserved.

changes.title: Northern Ireland county progress
changes.description: Northern Ireland's settlements are now linked to their historic counties, so they can contribute to your county progress.

changes.title: Keep up with What's new
changes.description: Open What's new in Utilities to see what each update brings. You can also contact Roadprints to report an issue or suggest a feature.
